statements.t: "With pivotal study startup activities underway in LN and planned FDA discussions regarding potential pivotal expansion to include lupus patients without nephritis, we look forward to providing a regulatory update and additional 12-month follow-up data from approximately 22 patients in the first quarter of 2027 followed by clinical data from our systemic sclerosis cohort in the second quarter.
Together with continued progress on ADI-212 and our in vivo CAR-T pipeline, we believe 2027 will be a catalyst-rich year for Adicet.”

Given the high DORIS remission rates reported in the September 2026 clinical data update, the Company plans to engage with the FDA in the fourth quarter of 2026 regarding the potential expansion of its pivotal development program to include lupus patients without nephritis.
The Company expects to provide an update on these discussions, as well as additional clinical data from approximately 22 patients with at least 12 months of follow-up, in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects to report clinical data evaluating prula-cel in SSc in the second quarter of 2027.
Based on progress to date, The Company plans to initiate its first in vivo CAR-T program in the second half of 2027.
